name: ai-memory
description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

issues.title: RFC: surface what memory holds about a file when the agent opens it (opt-in)

Agent-to-operator decision requests on top of cross-project messaging: in scope?
Memory poisoning: track whether a compiled page came from a tool result
Boundary question: optional `ai-memory-thesaurus` companion that tells the agent where the repository's docs cover each topic (follow-up to #700)
Lint: flag bulk review bumps and implicit supersession

## Install
```bash
# Linux/macOS, no root: checksum-verified release binary under ~/.local, then one-step setup
curl -fsSL https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/download/v3.4.6/install.sh | AI_MEMORY_VERSION=3.4.6 sh
ai-memory setup

# Arch Linux (AUR)
yay -S ai-memory-bin      # prebuilt Linux x86_64/aarch64 binary
yay -S ai-memory          # builds from source

# Fedora: download the matching RPM below, then run sudo dnf install ./ai-memory-<version>-1.<arch>.rpm

# Docker
docker pull akitaonrails/ai-memory:3.4.6

# macOS aarch64/x86_64 (no toolchain): download the matching ai-memory-macos-<arch>.tar.gz below,
# extract it, and follow the bundled docs/macos.md.

# Windows x86_64, no admin (PowerShell): checksum-verified release under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs, then one-step setup
$env:AI_MEMORY_VERSION='3.4.6'; irm https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/download/v3.4.6/install.ps1 | iex
ai-memory setup

# Windows (Scoop)
scoop bucket add akitaonrails https://github.com/akitaonrails/scoop-bucket
scoop install ai-memory
ai-memory setup

# From source
cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory --tag v3.4.6
```
